lines.text: Because the robot re-asks "where is the goal" every loop, the goal is allowed to move.
Driving to a tag, it starts with the field map, then switches to the spot it measures from the tag itself.
Driving to a game piece, the goal is wherever the camera sees it.
Same loop, every time. It's done when it's within two centimeters, within two degrees, and nearly stopped. Next video: how it measures that tag.
